map.排卵日 = 8/1 + (28−14) = 8/15；易孕期 = 8/10 ~: Ovulation day = 8/1 + (28−14) = 8/15; the fertile window = 8/10 to 8/19; the next period starts 8/29 (a 5-day period from 8/29). Note: the calendar method has an annual failure rate of about 24% for contraception. …
map.推算排卵日与易孕期：输入末次月经、周期长度、经期天数，排卵日 ≈ LMP + (: Estimate the ovulation day and fertile window: enter the last menstrual period, cycle length and period length; ovulation day ≈ LMP + (cycle − 14); the fertile window = ovulation day ±5 days (sperm survive for several days).
map.推算下次月经：下次月经 ≈ LMP + 周期；月经期按经期天数标记。周期日历把每: Estimate the next period: next period ≈ LMP + cycle length; the period days are marked by the period length. The cycle calendar labels each day as period, fertile or safe.
map.认识安全期局限：排卵受情绪、疾病、压力影响会提前或推后，日历法只能做健康管理参考: Understand the limits of the calendar method: ovulation shifts earlier or later with mood, illness and stress, so the calendar method is only a health management reference and never reliable contraception.
map.算例：LMP 2026-08-01、周期 28 天、经期 5 天: Worked example: LMP 2026-08-01, cycle 28 days, period 5 days
map.可靠方式包括避孕套、短效口服避孕药、宫内节育器等；安全期/体外射精失败率高，不建: Reliable methods include condoms, short-acting oral contraceptives and intrauterine devices; the calendar method and withdrawal have high failure rates and should not be used alone
map.安全期为什么不可靠？: Why is the calendar method unreliable?
map.女性排卵可因压力、疾病、旅行等波动 ±数天，且精子宫内可存活约 5 天、卵子约: Female ovulation can shift by several days due to stress, illness or travel, and sperm survive about 5 days in the uterus while the egg survives about 1 day, so the fertile window is wide and calendar estimates easily miss it.
map.想避孕该用什么？: What should I use for contraception?
map.可靠方式包括避孕套、短效口服避孕药、宫内节育器等；安全期/体外射精失败率高，不建: Reliable methods include condoms, short-acting oral contraceptives and intrauterine devices; the calendar method and withdrawal have high failure rates and should not be used alone. Consult a doctor if you have questions.
